title: Onboarding Redesign Review
summary: Discussion covered Onboarding, Activation, Templates, Customer Success. The team reached 2 clear decision(s) and assigned follow-up work.
decisions: Make onboarding outcome-based rather than feature-based
Trigger human help when an account misses day-14 activation

action_items.task: Make onboarding outcome-based rather than feature-based
Trigger human help when an account misses day-14 activation

transcript.speaker: Ishita Nair
transcript.text: Let's focus today's discussion on Onboarding, Activation, Templates.

transcript.speaker: Ritika Jain
transcript.text: I want this tested as a controlled experiment so we know whether it changes activation or just clicks.

transcript.speaker: Nisha Kapoor
transcript.text: The customer pattern matters more than the loudest individual request. We should act on repeat behavior.

transcript.speaker: Ananya Bose
transcript.text: A timed intervention will work better than asking CSMs to manually watch every account.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: The product problem is not lack of ideas. It is choosing the smallest set that creates repeat value.

transcript.speaker: Ishita Nair
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we make onboarding outcome-based rather than feature-based.

transcript.speaker: Ritika Jain
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we trigger human help when an account misses day-14 activation.

transcript.speaker: Ishita Nair
transcript.text: Okay, we are aligned on trigger human help when an account misses day-14 activation. Let's capture owners and move.
